t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The points awarded seem to be random. There was no recognised pattern in relation to position of the gnomes, the gnome itself or the colour of the baskets.

vb_textbox.text: I tried hard to identify a pattern but couldn't find one that was consistent. I considered certain gnomes scoring higher than others, the height of the gnomes, the position of the gnomes (left or right), association between coloured gnomes and the coloured baskets, red baskets scoring differently to yellow. At one point I felt that I was scoring well with the red, pink and purple gnome but it didn't last for the full game. I even tried alternating between left and right but this didn't seem to identify a pattern either. IN the last round I just chose randomly and didn't notice a difference in the number of points scored from those rounds when I tried to identify a pattern. Good luck, sorry I couldn't be more help.
